label: Season & weather · Qwen Image 2.1
blurb: Turns the scene in Image 1 into another season, weather or time of day. Everything stays where it is.
source: ComfyUI template image_qwen_image_2_1_image_edit (prompt enhancer left out)
tips: Combine a season with a light: 'winter, sunset'.

inputs.label: Scene
inputs.hint: A landscape, street or city view.

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Change the season and weather in <image1> to: deep winter, heavy snowfall. Update the sky, light, ground, plants and surfaces to match, consistently across the whole picture. Keep the composition, buildings, landscape and every object in its place.

inputs.label: Step cache
inputs.help: Where Qwen 2.1 keeps its step cache. cpu (RAM) is safe on 16 GB cards and costs little speed. auto and gpu take spare VRAM and can run out of memory.
